notes:
- 新增 App 内更新：自动检查并后台下载，正常退出时安装，不会主动打断使用。In-app updates download in the background and install on Quit without interrupting your work.
- 安装会等待录音、处理和写入完成；保存失败则取消退出。Updates wait for active work and saving; save failures cancel Quit.
- 优化长短语音的口语整理、改口和分段，支持按应用选择整理方式；未选择过的整理偏好默认速度优先。Improved speech cleanup, self-corrections and paragraph layout, with per-app choices and speed as the default preference.
- 自动检查和自动下载可分别关闭，保留已有选择；开发版不检查更新。Automatic checks and downloads have separate controls, preserve existing choices, and stay disabled in development builds.
